C1346.title: Cloudflare Deploys Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Agreement to Defend Against Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later Attacks
C1346.summary: Cloudflare has been researching post-quantum cryptography since 2017 and has now deployed post-quantum hybrid key agreement protocols such as X25519MLKEM768. The move aims to counter harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks, where adversaries collect encrypted data today with the intent of decrypting it once sufficiently powerful quantum computers become available.
